notes.title: Steam Spring Sale Has Started!
New Update Inbound!
notes.content:
Attention, all Survivors!

We are pleased to announce the release of an update for FatalZone, which brings some changes to the game and improves optimization. In addition, we have prepared a small surprise and added Steam collectibles, namely cards and badges — you can now grow your very own pet zombie to be displayed in your profile!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/8d9042be5b752eb2f5826768fbb98ee0c74ebb4e.png[/img]

Gameplay Changes:

Stats, such as damage done with skills and weapons, can now be viewed at the end of a raid.

Misc Improvements:

Drones have been rebalanced and their AoE around the character has been increased.

Issues regarding crashes and freezes at the results screen have also been addressed. The game should be more stable now, so it is high time to get fully immersed in the world of FatalZone!

notes.title: Raid Survivors Festival is LIVE!
FatalZone v1.0
notes.content:
Attention, Survivors!

Our Early Access journey is coming to an end—with the update 1.0, we celebrate the game's full official release!

Thanks everyone for your active participation in the development of our project! Your feedback and support helped us make FatalZone even better.

[previewyoutube=5_3KmbWAodE;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/8d9042be5b752eb2f5826768fbb98ee0c74ebb4e.png[/img]

The full version of the game will include:
[list][*]5 locations;
[*] 9 playable classes;
[*] 57 unique perks for your Mercs;
[*] 9 weapon types;
[*] 9 armor types;
[*] 9 ultimate abilities;
[*] 43 offensive and defensive skills;
[*] 15 weapon and offensive skill evolutions;
[*] 41 enemy variations (with 21 unique designs);
[*] 6 difficulty levels for all locations;
[*] 7 base buildings, each with their own functionality and 10 upgrade levels;
[*] 51 Merc stats;
[*] Numerous mutations that randomize said stats;
[*] 5 boosters (not counting resources and experience);
[*] 330 total achievements.[/list]
The full version also includes a myriad of changes aimed at making your gaming experience much more stable and comfortable. From GUI improvements and bug fixes to full controller support—FatalZone plays better now than ever before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/8d9042be5b752eb2f5826768fbb98ee0c74ebb4e.png[/img]

So, let's get down to business... What's new in version 1.0?

New content:[list][*] New location – Abandoned Factory. Survivors will need to hold out here for 20 minutes to successfully complete the raid.
[*] New enemy – Termite
After traveling for a certain distance, it will remember the Merc's position and launch a delayed fire attack that can damager other zombies, but not the Termite itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/582002480b572000b00deecf36379939b47a8d2a.gif[/img]

[*] New class – Hacker
Each level will raise the Hacker's base intelligence stat, but the bonus is reset upon revival.
[*] New weapon – Guan Dao
Deals consecutive hits and applies the Weakening effect.
With the "Dragon's Will" Evolution, this weapon will summon a dragon with every sixth hit, dealing AoE toxic damage and applying Weakening to all affected targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/8a3167f9e0ab34f67d9f754fcd3dde015001b7b9.gif[/img]

[*] New skills:
"Shield of Dawn" – deals AoE fire damage around the Merc whenever they get wounded;
"Burner" – airdrops in a turret that targets the nearest zombies and deals AoE fire damage.
[*] New unique Pyro perk – "Heat Drop"
Upon receiving damage, releases a wave of steam around the character.
[*] New mechanics – Class Ultimates:
Survivor – "Doom Wave";
Veteran – "Battle Brotherhood";
Brawler – "Deathcore";
Tank – "Earthshaker";
Pyro – "Hell Furnace";
Biotech – "Lifeless Flowers";
Scavenger – "Vortex";
Saboteur – "Bountiful Harvest."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/370ed709e70a98b511a6684155778f24ed788694.gif[/img]

Ultimate abilities only charge when killing zombies, and the charge rate is unique for each class. Activated by pressing the R key (LT/RT buttons on the gamepad).
[*] Numerous new achievements![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/8d9042be5b752eb2f5826768fbb98ee0c74ebb4e.png[/img]

Other changes:
[list][*] Containers, interactive points, and boxes will no longer spawn inside environmental objects.
[*] The heartbeat sound is turned off if the Merc recovers over 30% of their HP at once.
[*] Market:
An information window will appear when you first unlock this building.
[*] Gate:
Now sports an updated map.
[*] Log:
Can now be enabled/disabled in the game's settings.
[*] Chests:
The reward in chests has been increased after reaching max level.
[*] Brawler (all levels):
Increased armor, electric damage, skill cooldown, and luck.
[*] Survivor (all levels):
Adjusted regeneration and resurrection skills, as well as running speed and bonuses to fire, electric, and toxic damage.
[*] Pyro (all levels):
Adjusted bonuses to running speed, AoE, and fire damage, as well as its duration.
[*] Boomerang:
Changed damage type: Normal → Fire;
Added afterburn for all levels.
[*] Full Metal Cyclone:
Reduced cooldown speed: 3.3 → 2.5 sec;
Increased projectile speed: 18 → 25 m/s.[/list]
These and other changes, including minor visual and audio fixes, await you in the new update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/8d9042be5b752eb2f5826768fbb98ee0c74ebb4e.png[/img]

We are pleased to announce a new bundle — now with 100% more Brotato!
The BroZone bundle is perfect for those who like to arm themselves to the teeth and give a worthy rebuff to all their enemies.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1942280/Brotato/]Brotato[/url] is an arena shooter with dozens of playable characters, hundreds of items, and a myriad of powerful weapons. Collect resources, gain experience, and become strong enough to withstand any battle by destroying as many enemies as possible along your path!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45278/BroZone/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/8d9042be5b752eb2f5826768fbb98ee0c74ebb4e.png[/img]

We would like to thank you for your interest in the project and your active support. Good luck in battle!

notes.title: The Game’s Full Version is Almost Here!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that FatalZone is now closer to release than ever before: on September 17, the game shall leave early access with a major update that will bring a sea of ​​new content! Replenish your Mercs' ranks with fresh blood and their arsenal with novel arms and gear. Explore a new location and encounter previously unseen enemies… This and much more awaits you in the full version of the game!

We would like to give special thanks to everyone who has stayed with and supported us on the way to FatalZone’s long-awaited release! And for those who have just decided to join the battle for the fate of humanity, we wish you a pleasant time in your fight against endless undead hordes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/8d9042be5b752eb2f5826768fbb98ee0c74ebb4e.png[/img]

We are also happy to announce a new bundle that lovers of frantic action the world over can band around!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/577e87c153dc083fadaf188e69b92fad7760893b.png[/img] The Chaotic Evil bundle is designed to satiate one’s appetite for physics-based gameplay, wild chases, and large-scale destruction!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1482380/Maniac/]Maniac[/url] is a game where you bet on mayhem! The whole world is against you, and your madness shall seed Chaos all around! 6 characters with unique skills and tons of weapons, a constantly changing world to destroy, and a built-in map editor to express your creativity! Just make sure not to fall into any traps laid down by your enemies… and may Chaos be with you!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44395/Chaotic_Evil/

notes.content:
What could be better than many awesome discounts and a hot announcement of our new upcoming project? We are excited to unveil the launch of our own Summer Sale on Steam! Only until August 2, purchase all 101XP games at the best of prices!

Walk the path from birth until true death in the harsh world of the critically acclaimed narrative-driven RPG—[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272160/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Sir_Brante/]The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante[/url]! Be prepared to make difficult choices and answer for your fateful decisions that lead to irreversible consequences.

Get immersed in the retro-futuristic world of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1596730/Dynopunk/]Dynopunk[/url], where the main character, Chris the T. rex, runs a repair shop and pursues his life’s dream, all set to a nostalgic Lo-Fi soundtrack!

Try on the mayor’s suit in the acute social visual novel [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1146600/For_the_People/]For the People[/url], where you will sort out your citizens' appeals and uncover political conspiracies.

Or maybe you are into thrilling and atmospheric adventures? Then why not go on a journey through the world of nightmares and grim fairy stories in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1307690/The_Darkest_Tales/]The Darkest Tales[/url], or search the ruins of post-apocalyptic Japan as a cyber samurai in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294880/Blind_Fate_Edo_no_Yami/]Blind Fate: Edo no Yami[/url]?

Or perhaps you are looking to set aside all the philosophy and dramatic storytelling to simply enjoy the fast-paced gameplay of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488510/FatalZone/]FatalZone [/url]and annihilate hordes of abominable undead?

And if you feel like acquiring several games at once—or it just so happens that you already have some of them and are looking to complete your collection—then our lucrative bundle offers will make such a purchase even more cost-effective!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/101xp/sale/101XPpublishersale2024][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38127382/0f2797f02b08c9e70b1232325c353d53bb84ec73.jpg[/img][/url]

The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian is a narrative-driven RPG that takes place on the pages of a book, where you will become not just a hero but the heir to the throne of the Blessed Arknian Empire—the seat of power in the world ruled by real and merciless gods. A new life-long journey awaits, full of difficult moral dilemmas, palace intrigue, the search for answers to the mysteries of creation, and heavy choices with far-reaching consequences not only for yourself but your entire Imperial domain.

Wishlist The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian now!

notes.title: The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian — a new narrative RPG from Schisma Games
notes.content:
It is our pleasure to announce a new narrative roleplay adventure from the minds behind [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272160/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Sir_Brante/]The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante[/url]!

The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian is a narrative roleplaying game that casts the player as the heir to the Blessed Arknian Empire, who must carve out a destiny for his nation. The world is grim, and the gods are eager to punish anyone who breaks their commandments. People live preordained lives, their fates sealed the moment they are born. It is up to the player to decide what kind of leader they will be: uphold the established order, or build a new kind of future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2936290/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Prince_Jerian/

You, Prince Jerian of House Tempest, must embark on a lifelong journey. It starts in your childhood, blissfully ignorant of your destiny, and continues into maturity as you take up a role you have been primed for since birth: emperor. As crown prince, you must not only understand your country and its culture, but also make many difficult choices that affect the fragile balance of powers in the Empire, and inside yourself. If you go where political circumstance and family obligations guide you, you risk losing yourself in the chaos. Can you keep yourself whole, or will you shatter?

Check out the trailer, which will give you some first impressions about the upcoming game!

[previewyoutube=LsJb0TVRytc;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition, to celebrate the official announcement of the game, we are releasing a special video address from the development team at Schisma Games, in which they will pull back the veil of mystery shrouding the contents of their upcoming title. Come watch!

[previewyoutube=RdUQLk17Vqo;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is currently in development. Wishlist The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian now and subscribe to our newsletter to never miss an update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38127382/e187dfde67bda82ee5d3133de0a985083203b26e.gif[/img]

Join our bustling [url=https://discord.gg/YWRm476CVE]Discord community[/url], the best place to make the wait for the new game a bit more enjoyable. Any questions you have, you can ask there. Discuss the game world with like-minded players, share your ideas and suggestions, and be among the first to hear any news about the game!

The third content update for the game has dropped last week. If you have already checked it out, please tell us your impressions!

notes.title: Early Access | Update #3
notes.content:
Attention, Survivors!

We are pleased to announce the release of the third update for FatalZone, which, in addition to minor changes and optimizations, also includes new content!

[previewyoutube=GtvfpNJIqMM;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/8d9042be5b752eb2f5826768fbb98ee0c74ebb4e.png[/img]

New items:
[list][*] New character class — Saboteur:
Every 120 seconds, the Saboteur activates one of two abilities, depending on his current HP:
— if HP is above 50%, Absolute Evasion is activated, rendering the Saboteur immune to enemy-inflicted damage for 20 seconds and boosting his own damage by 30%;
— if HP is below 50%, Absorption is activated, granting the Saboteur invulnerability for 20 seconds and a temporary 30% movement speed bonus, while also converting 50% of incoming damage into healing.
[*] New boss — Grapper;
[*] New Weapon Workshop building functionality:
You can now change your characters' equipment at the Workshop at any time!
[*] New skills:
"Thunder Shurikens" — throws several projectiles at random points in a semicircle in front of the character that penetrate any number of enemies and inflict physical damage;
"Dark Fusion Cube" — places a cube on the ground that shoots out rays of dark fire after a short pause.
[*] New enemies:
Zombie Bear dashes at the Merc whenever it gets into the range of 4 and 10 meters from them. If the beast is closer or further than the specified distance, it will give chase at regular speed;
Ergot is an enemy surrounded by a damage-dealing aura that follows the Merc tirelessly and likes to hang out close to them.
[*] "Kill all zombies" mini-game;
[*] New unique Biotech perk — "Toxic Fungus":
Every 25 seconds, it creates a mushroom that deals AoE damage over the next 10 seconds.
[*] New achievements.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/8d9042be5b752eb2f5826768fbb98ee0c74ebb4e.png[/img]

Other changes:
[list][*] Ghost Rider
New music tracks have been added;
Reduced Fire Trail duration: 5 > 3 sec.
[*] Damage numbers:
Reduced font size;
Reduced display time;
Adjusted display priority — the numbers will no longer overlap the Merc and their foes.
[*] Interactive points:
Bosses spawned by triggering interactive zones will now have a dedicated health bar.
[*] EVAC:
The chest under the dome can now only be of first rarity.
[*] Graphics and sounds:
Added unique effects and sounds when defeating certain enemy types.
[*] HQ:
Will now also display achievement names.
[*] "Forest" Location:
Mutators now will spawn fewer Exploding Zombies;
Mutators now will spawn fewer Large Zombies.
[*] Seismic Hammer:
Reduced the base damage AoE for all levels;
Increased the damage AoE for the Cataclysm Evolution.
[*] Spear:
Increased base damage for all levels.
[*] Shotgun:
Increased base damage for all levels;
Burning damage has been increased when equipped with the corresponding Evolution, but its duration has been shortened.
[*] Bat:
Increased base damage for all levels.

The update also brings many other changes, including minor visual and audio fixes![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/8d9042be5b752eb2f5826768fbb98ee0c74ebb4e.png[/img]

We would like to thank you for your patience and active support, and hope that you will stay tuned to see the future of FatalZone unfold with us!

We are pleased to announce the release of the second update for FatalZone, which brings new in-game content! It also tweaks the balance a bit and introduces a lot of other changes, including improved optimization.

[previewyoutube=eyK_9f2Rtrs;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/8d9042be5b752eb2f5826768fbb98ee0c74ebb4e.png[/img]
New features:[list]
[*] Added the "Desolate Park" location, available at Gate level 4;
[*] Added the "Clown" boss;
[*] Added the "Market" building:
Here, you can exchange one type of resource for another. The exchange rate will become more favorable as the building levels up.
[*] Added the "Let's Rock" perk for Brawler-class Mercs:
Once every X sec. releases a sound wave that pushes enemies around for X meters and stuns them for X sec.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/bada6277e3ea52e15bc079c873b98761f5c0878d.gif[/img]

[*] Added the "Seismic Hammer" weapon:
It deals AoE electric damage, repelling and stunning enemies. Also has the "Cataclysm" evo: once unlocked, the shockwave will spread sideways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/4067d3b5c3dbc1025f075901596b39a35f5f40d9.gif[/img]

[*] Added new skills:
"Deadly Needle" — shoots a dart at the nearest enemy, dealing toxic damage with an X% chance to instantly eliminate the target;
"Graviton" — launches a flying projectile in a random direction that blows up after a while, drawing enemies to the epicenter of the explosion and dealing physical damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/67cc6ec9344a95320b0a9f511306871ba7ffd8cc.gif[/img]

[*] Added new enemies:
Ghost Rider — a zombie that moves in a straight line to the opposite edge of the screen, leaving a trail of fire behind and dealing physical damage upon contact;
Electro Zombies — enemies that gather in groups of 12 to form rings that deal electrical damage in an arc and repel the Merc away. They do not move and are immune to knockback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/47d6c42bffb08538c3ce24cd45b095feb11858ca.gif[/img]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/8d9042be5b752eb2f5826768fbb98ee0c74ebb4e.png[/img]

[*] Gate:
Added the 4th level to this building.
[*] Tank class:
Reduced normal damage penalty: -50% → -25%.
[*] Biotech class:
Increased regeneration: 1 HP/sec. → 2 HP/sec.
[*] Superior Ammo:
Increased normal damage bonus;
Reduced AoE size bonus for all levels.
[*] Crossbow:
Modified basic weapon stats.
[*] Bat:
Reduced blast damage area for all levels;
Reduced projectile size for all levels;
Completely removed AoE damage bonus, increased normal damage bonus for all levels (when upgraded at the base).
[*] Shotgun:
Reduced AoE size bonus for all levels (when upgraded at the base).
[*] Spear:
Reduced AoE size bonus for all levels (when upgraded at the base).
[*] Toxic Grenade:
Increased toxic damage for all levels;
Reduced AoE for all levels.
[*] Frag Grenade:
Reduced the AoE for all the skill's levels.
[*] Molotov Cocktail:
Reduced the AoE for all the skill's levels.
[*] Grenade Launcher:
Fixed a bug where the skill would sometimes deal no damage.
[*] Gigantism:
Reduced AoE size bonus for all levels;
Reduced projectile size bonus for all levels.
[*] "Generosity” Skill:
Reduced AoE size bonus: 30% → 15%.
[*] "Cell Regen" Defensive Skill:
Increased regeneration values at all levels.
[*] "Fire Storm" Armor:
Reduced AoE size bonus for all levels (when upgraded at the base).[/list]
There are other misc changes, including minor visual and audio bugfixes.

notes.title: Early Access | Update #1
notes.content:
Attention, survivors!

We've been following your feedback and ideas for improving FatalZone and were hard at work not only fixing bugs but also adding new content. Finally, we're excited to bring you the first update, so here’s its list of changes:

New features:
[list][*]Added a notification log so that you never miss one of the following:
- the start of an evacuation;
- resource pickups;
- unique character perks activation;
- interactive points spawning;
- resource containers popping up on the current map;
- appearance of a skill-granting mark.
[*]Added interactive point mechanics. These are zones, upon entering which you will encounter additional enemies.
So don't stand still anymore! Explore locations during raids to level up your character and return to base with even more resources!
[*]New navigation system — radar!
- arrows have been replaced with icons pointing towards nearby crates;
- the distance to an object can be determined by the corresponding icon’s size: the farther away an object is, the smaller its icon will be;
- the scale around the icon indicates the remaining time before the object will disappear;
- use the E key to turn the radar on and off.

This is how it looked like before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/f23090cdabd77d1f2395bb31af4eda1d6604935d.png[/img]

Now the radar looks like this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/836f1e0d4409db72730c50c8dec4ef24a196e051.png[/img]

[*]Added containers with more resources than crates. These have a unique appearance and come in several sizes that affect the number of resources inside. They can also hold multiple resource types at once.
[*]Added unique containers that can hold skills. Note that you can’t evolve a skill with such containers, and that they will stop spawning once all of your skills reach max level.
[*]Leveling up the Infirmary building now provides new bonuses:
- at level 2, a Healing Dome will spawn at the EVAC Zone and heal 50 HP every 0.5 seconds on player contact (the dome disappears alongside the evacuation point);
- at level 3, the dome will also stun and repel enemies. Its stun duration is 5 seconds;
- at level 4, a chest with a parachute icon will appear at the EVAC Zone. Note that it will also disappear alongside it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/f36cb8414e014b9dbbbb5c435d94269f6574f5eb.gif[/img]

[*]The "Survivor" class now has the unique "Ghost Chance" perk: upon receiving lethal damage, if the Merc has no resurrection charges, they will become invulnerable for 20 seconds. Pick up a first-aid kit or heal under the EVAC Zone Dome during this time to survive. Otherwise, the character will die, and the raid will fail. Once the perk is activated, an icon and a scale showing the time remaining will appear above the character.
[*]The "Scavenger" class now has the unique "Uncontrolled Magnetism" perk: when activated, all experience spheres, amplifiers, and resources on the location will be instantly collected. The perk triggers once every few seconds and doesn’t affect chests, interactive and evacuation points, or resource and skill containers.
[*]The Veteran class now has the new unique "Fire Shower" perk: once every few seconds, the character receives a Hellfire drone with a unique appearance. Picking up two drones will prolong the skill's duration.
[*]A sound was added when activating the Tank class’s temporary shield.
[*]Enemy changes:
- Fireman’s fire protection was raised from 0 to 50%;
- Brigade Commander’s fire protection was raised from 0 to 100%;
- Policeman’s shotgun shell color has been changed;
- Spitfire’s shell color has been changed from green to red, plus a bug that sometimes rendered their shells invisible has been fixed.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/e6b6e4af302f231459c721cd657d2807125a1b0e.png[/img]

Misc changes:
[list][*]Evacuation:
Changed the effective zone from a rhombus to an ellipse so that it matches the visual representation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/690d36335ca0229984130daa341b993a954ffa55.gif[/img]

[*]Chests:
Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented the game from being paused when opening a chest.
[*]Mutations:
Fixed a bug where the Merc’s stats did not immediately take any received penalties and mutations into account upon leaving a raid.
[*]Level Ups:
The "Refresh List" button can now be selected with the keyboard by pressing the S or the downward arrow keys.
[*]"Home Run" Skill:
Fixed a bug that caused the main projectile’s fragments to hit the same target;
Reduced the number of projectile splits from 2 to 1.
[*]Katana and Spear:
Fixed a bug that caused the weapon to miss its target.
[*]Steam Achievements:
Fixed a number of issues with unlocking certain achievements.[/list]
Plus some other minor fixes! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/e6b6e4af302f231459c721cd657d2807125a1b0e.png[/img]

We’d like to thank you for your patience and active support, and hope that you’ll stick with us to see FatalZone’s future unfold!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341241/f4d77ed09525488e9c0aef83dd8766ecc2c3c8fd.png[/img]We also want to remind you about a great bundle for fans of horror and mystery.
20 Minutes Till Dawn — Fight off Lovecraftian monsters to make it through the night. Choose your hero from a long list of characters, unlock over 50 different upgrades, and strive to survive in this difficult battle against eldritch evil!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36018/Dawn_of_Zombies/

notes.title: Early Access | Hotfix #2
Early Access | Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Attention, survivors!

First of all we want to thank you for your feedback, it helps us a lot in our work! We are working hard to address most common issues and suggestions and are ready to present you the first hotfix, in which we tried to emphasize on improving the performance of the game.

Here is the list of changes:
[list]
[*]reduced the number of collision checks;
[*]fixed the work of the katana;
[*]set the maximum for the reload bonus to 99%.[/list]

We've also reworked the "Display Stun, Burn and Weakness Effects" setting - it's now called "Display Minor Visual Effects" and now additionally disables effects when taking damage and killing zombies, slightly reduces the maximum number of enemies on the screen and significantly reduces the number of experience spheres. 
Disabling the "Minor Visual Effects Display" and "Damage Display" settings should help players experiencing performance drops.

We're still working on some of the other issues you've reported, but that's the first bit we'd like to share with y'all.

Thank you for your support! Don't forget to share your experiences on [url=https://discord.gg/BZwCAS2Vma]our Discord server![/url]

Over and out!

notes.title: FatalZone: Outbreak | Play for free!
notes.content:
The world has been ravaged by a zombie virus, but humanity doesn’t give up that easily!

[b]FatalZone: Outbreak[/b] is the free version of a bullet heaven zombie apocalypse shooter where you have to clear a path to safety through hordes of the living dead. 

Risk your merc to get resources and upgrade your base, level up your skills, and develop a deadly build to fight the undead. In this world, whatever doesn’t kill you makes you stronger! But remember, no one is immortal...

Leave a review on Steam and share your feedback with us in our [url=https://discord.gg/BZwCAS2Vma]Discord server[/url] where you can discuss your favorite builds and characters with fellow survivors!

We appreciate your support and interest in our game and hope you'll stick around to see the future of FatalZone! Don't forget to wishlist the game, and stay tuned for the future announcements!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488510
